## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The opening front-matter (*juànshǒu* 卷首) volume of the three-text *Fǎhuá jīng kēshí* commentarial complex by [佛閑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%96%91) Fóxián 佛閑 (also referenced as **Fóxián Xùyī** 佛閑勗伊大師) of the **Pǔdésì** 普德寺 in Nánjīng, with editorial supplementation by his disciple [智一](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E4%B8%80) Zhìyī 智一. The three-text complex — this work ([KR6d0092](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0092), front matter), the *Kēshí kē* ([KR6d0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0093), sectional analysis), and the *Kēshí* proper ([KR6d0094](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0094), main commentary, 7 *juan*) — represents the principal early-Kāngxī Nánjīng Buddhist contribution to the Lotus Sūtra commentarial corpus.

**Abstract**

Fóxián's *Kēshí xuántán juànshǒu* establishes the doctrinal-historical framework for the entire *Kēshí* complex: it provides the introductory exposition of the Lotus Sūtra's place in the Mahāyāna canonical tradition, the principal interpretive issues, and the editorial method to be employed in the subsequent main commentary. The work is structurally parallel to other three-text commentarial complexes of the early-Qīng period ([智祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E7%A5%A5) Zhìxiáng's *Shòushǒu* complex, [KR6d0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0087)–[KR6d0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0089); [大義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E7%BE%A9) Dàyì's *Dàchéng* complex, [KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084)–[KR6d0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0086)).

The dating is securely fixed by Zhìyī's 1705 preface, with composition presumably extending back through Fóxián's late-Kāngxī productive period (c. 1700–1705).
